onset.Description: Onset (in seconds) of the event from the beginning of the first datapoint. Negative onsets account for events before the first stored data point.

duration.Description: Duration of the event in seconds from onset. Must be zero, positive, or 'n/a' if unavailable. A zero value indicates an impulse event.

sample.Description: The event onset time in number of sampling points.First sample is 0.

value.Description: The event code (also known as trigger code or event ID) associated with the event.

trial_type.Description: The type, category, or name of the event.

block_id.Description: Experimental block number in presentation order, from 1 to 6.

trial_id.Description: Sequential stimulus trial number within the subject, from 1 to 60.

frequency.Description: Stimulation frequency of the SSVEP flicker.

transparency.Description: Transparency level of the background/stimulus blending.

color.Description: Color pair used for the flickering stimulus.

bg_image_id.Description: Identifier of the background image shown during the trial, from bg01 to bg30.
